title: This Owl Catches Mice in Total Darkness With Mismatched Ears
subject: barn owl

scenes.text: An owl can catch a mouse in a pitch black room, and it can't see a thing.
Scientists tested barn owls in soundproofed, totally dark rooms. They still struck the target.
The target was a sound. Owls aimed within about two degrees, with no light at all.
Here's the trick. Its ears sit at different heights, so a sound reaches one slightly before the other.
Its stiff, dish-shaped face feathers funnel sound inward, and its wing edges are serrated, so it arrives in silence.
Total darkness, total silence, and the mouse never knew.

description:
An owl can catch a mouse in a pitch black room.
Barn owls pinpoint sound to within about two degrees, thanks to uneven ears and a dish-shaped face.
